about_the_game:
Skill doesn’t matter! It’s a thrilling card battle anyone can win!

Players take turns rolling four dice to complete combinations shown on their cards and launch attacks.
Match the right combo, and it’s your big chance!
Will you deal massive damage, or draw extra cards to prepare for the next turn? The strategy is up to you.

With cards for attack, defense, and support, you’ll need to master the keep and reroll system to play the perfect hand and gain the upper hand in battle.

A game system made for exciting multiplayer chaos

Up to four players can join the battle.
With three or more players, your attacks hit both neighbors, making the fight even faster and more intense.

As the game progresses, new twists appear—like using the previous player’s dice roll—turning every move into a game-changer.

Even if you're knocked out… your fight isn’t over yet.

Don’t give up—even when you’re down! Ghost Mode is your revenge.

In this game, you’re never really out.
Even after defeat, you can come back as a ghost to interfere with the living and seek revenge!

And with one miraculous roll—if you land all the right faces—you might just make a legendary comeback.

Luck is your ultimate weapon. Can you seize victory?

“Wait, what!? They came back!?”
“No way... that roll was insane!!”

Expect gasps, laughter, and jaw-dropping reversals in this wild card-and-dice battle where no one’s safe until the very end.

Take your shot and experience the thrill of a single roll turning the whole game upside down!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10, 11
  • Processor: intel core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Match all the dice, and the comeback begins! With just dice and cards, up to 4 players face off in a thrilling battle. Match the dice shown on your card to attack — even if you're out, one last roll might turn it all around. Join the game of luck and strategy!
